+title: Keep the Qwen 3.5 system prompt the same when thinking goes off, so the prompt cache does not rebuild after a repeat stop
+---
+## Origin
+
+The foundationmodelsacpagent-19 session sent this request from a SWE-bench run of FoundationModelsACPAgent. The user approved that this task goes on the Router board. The code change is in the fork `../mlx-swift-lm` (branch `stable`). Send the commit to foundationmodelsacpagent-19 when the task is done.
+
+## Evidence
+
+File `bench/cacheplan.code-context-1008.log` in FoundationModelsACPAgent, os_log category `ExecutorPromptCache`, 2026-10-08:
+- 10:10:21.115, session 01M4E0GY2GXJYFDDP44EV4HAZ1: `rendered=26937 reused=0 fed=26937 rule=rebuild divergence=3`.
+  - The cached ledger starts with `Reasoning effort is set to xhigh. Please think carefully…`.
+  - The new render starts with `# Tools\n\nYou have access to the following functions:`.
+- Immediately before it, at transcript seq 3422–3424, a repeat stop occurred: `repetition.tokens=2052 recovery=1`.
+- That run has 76 plans. This is the only rebuild. The 69 other turns show `rule=splice`.
+
+## Cause
+
+1. After a repeat stop, the recovery runs with `reasoningOff: true` (`RoutedSessionActorRepetitionWatch.swift:579, 583, 613`).
+2. That sets `ReasoningOffRequest.reasoningLevel = .custom("no_think")` (`ReasoningOffRequest.swift:44-47`, `LiveModelLoader.swift:440`). Thus the template gets `enable_thinking=false`.
+3. The chat template of `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` (chat_template.jinja:45-60) writes `Reasoning effort is set to xhigh…` into the system block only when `enable_thinking` is undefined or true. Thus, when thinking goes off, the system prompt changes at token 3.
+4. This model is a hybrid that has recurrent layers. Its cache cannot go back to an earlier position. Thus a change at token 3 causes a full prefill.
+5. When thinking comes back on after the recovery, the system prompt changes again, and a second full prefill occurs. Thus each repeat stop costs two full prefills. Each prefill takes 5 to 9 minutes at 90k to 150k tokens. Instance django__django-13964 paused for 554 s and 389 s after its repeat stops.
+
+## Fix
+
+- For this template, do not turn thinking off with `enable_thinking=false`.
+- Keep `enable_thinking` on in the render. Close the thinking at the end of the prompt: after the generation prompt, add an empty `<think>\n\n</think>\n\n`. The template writes this same tail for `enable_thinking=false`. But with this fix the system block does not change, so the cache can extend or splice.
+- The switch is in mlx-swift-lm: `QwenReasoningProtocol.qwen35` (`Libraries/MLXLMCommon/QwenReasoningProtocol.swift`), the `ReasoningPromptStrategy` in `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ReasoningConfig.swift`, and the reasoning-off path in `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift` (near lines 1401-1440 and 2637-2661) that `LiveModelLoader` uses through `ReasoningSwitchable`.
+- Do not change the behavior for the other Qwen protocols (`tagged`, `qwen3`) unless the same template defect applies to them. Record the result of that check on this card.
+- After the fork change is on mlx-swift-lm `stable` and pushed, update the mlx-swift-lm revision that Router resolves. If Router needs a code change, make it.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- Unit test in mlx-swift-lm: the render with thinking off has the same system block as the render with thinking on, and it ends with the generation prompt plus `<think>\n\n</think>\n\n`.
+- Real-model test with `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` weights: a turn with thinking on, then a recovery turn with thinking off, then a turn with thinking on again. Each turn after the first must log `rule=splice` or `rule=extend`. No turn may log `rule=rebuild`.
+- mlx-swift-lm tests pass, and Router `swift test` passes. #cross-repo #needs-fork #prompt-cache #real-model
\ No newline at end of file

+    - Thus "append `<think>\n\n</think>\n\n`" must REPLACE the open `<think>\n` of the thinking-on render. Appending the text `\n</think>\n\n` after `<think>\n` is wrong: a BPE tokenizer gives `\n` `\n` there, while the joint render (and the history render of the next turn) gives one `\n\n` token. Its convention: unit tests use a scripted processor that states the template contract; real templates render in `IntegrationTesting` from the HF cache. +    - `closedBlock`: thinking off renders with the flag ON (`additionalContext` gives `[key: true]`), and the new `ReasoningConfig.closingReasoning(in:with:tokenizer:)` cuts the render at the token where the open `<think>` block starts and appends the tokens of the whole closed block. Reason: the thinking-on generation prompt ends `<think>\n`; a plain append of `\n</think>\n\n` gives other tokens than the joint render (a BPE merges `\n\n`).
+    - `QwenReasoningProtocol.qwen35` uses `.closedBlock("<think>\n\n</think>\n\n")`. `tagged` and `qwen3` do not change.
+    - Both render paths use the new `MLXLanguageModel.Executor.ThinkingRender` (`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ThinkingRender.swift`): `preparedInput` (unconstrained path) and the tool path (`toolAwareRender` in place of `toolAwareContext`, allowed and required modes). The rank and the mask of the processor output stay the same.
+    - Parser and tool calls: the closed render ends with the same text as the template render for `enable_thinking=false`, thus the output does not start inside a think block (`reasoningPrimedInside` is false), and `thinkThenCallConfig` stays nil for thinking off, as before.
+
+    ### Check of `tagged` and `qwen3`
+    - `qwen3` (Qwen3-1.7B-4bit and Qwen3-4B-4bit templates in the local HF cache): `enable_thinking` is read only after `add_generation_prompt`. The system block does not change. No defect, no change.
+    - `tagged` (Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking, Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking templates on huggingface.co): the templates do not read `enable_thinking`. The system block does not change. No defect, no change.
+
+    ### Tests
+    - Unit, `Tests/MLXLMTests/ClosedReasoningBlockTests.swift` (9 tests): the strategy, the protocols, and the token cut with a tokenizer that has special think tags and a `\n\n` merge.
+    - Unit, `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/Qwen35ThinkingOffRenderTests.swift` (3 tests x no tools / tools): executor passes with a processor that states the Qwen 3.5 template contract. (a) the thinking-off render has the system block of thinking on and ends with the generation prompt + `<think>\n\n</think>\n\n`; (b) on -> off reuses past the system block; (c) off -> on reuses past the system block. RED before the fix (all 6 cases failed: reuse stopped inside the system block), GREEN after.
+    - Real template, `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/Qwen35ThinkingOffTemplateTests.swift` (3 tests x no tools / tools), renders the real `chat_template.jinja` of `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` (snapshot `97ab0819817ab1c61d7d39f9169fc71999915641`, tokenizer only, no weights): same system block; flag false changes the system block; same tail as the flag-false render; tokens equal a joint render of the text; on -> off: the off render starts with the whole on conversation; off -> on: the next on render extends the off tokens exactly. 6/6 passed.
+    - Why the real template is not in a SwiftPM unit target: mlx-swift-lm has no Jinja engine in its SwiftPM targets, and the test-partitioning rule forbids a real external file in a unit target. The repo convention: contract processors in unit tests, real templates in `IntegrationTesting`.
+    - Real-model acceptance test: `turnsWithThinkingOffAndOnAgainReuseTheTurnBefore` in `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/Qwen35SessionPromptCacheTests.swift`. Turn 1 on, turn 2 off (`reasoningLevel = .custom("no_think")`), turn 3 on. Each later turn must reuse at least the whole render of the turn before it (a hybrid model cannot rewind, thus reuse > 0 means `extend` or `splice`, reuse 0 means `rebuild`).
